enchantment.gear_forge.lightning_arrow.d: Summons lightning on hit, +10% lightning dmg/lvl
enchantment.gear_forge.frost_arrow.desc: Slows and damages target, longer slow duration per lvl
enchantment.gear_forge.mining_crit.desc: Chance to get double drops when mining
enchantment.gear_forge.ore_hunter.desc: Chance to get ore from stone
message.gear_forge.use_smithing_table: Please use this item on a Smithing Table!
tooltip.gear_forge.forge_hammer: Place in the smithing table's material slot with a gear, and put Diamonds in the template slot, to upgrade it by one level. The higher the level, the lower the success rate; on failure the level may stay, drop, or the gear may be destroyed. The number of Diamonds needed grows with the level.
tooltip.gear_forge.upgrade_crystal: Place a gem in the smithing table's equipment slot and this in the material slot to raise the gem's tier, which scales all of its effects.
tooltip.gear_forge.reroll_stone: Place in the smithing table's material slot to grant random affixes (1~5 affixes)
tooltip.gear_forge.transfer_orb: Place in the smithing table's material slot to toggle the weapon between main-hand and off-hand mode
tooltip.gear_forge.gem_remover: Place in the smithing table's material slot to remove the most recently socketed gem from the equipment
tooltip.gear_forge.reincarnation_stone: When your gear reaches its max upgrade level, place this in the material slot and the required material in the template slot to Reincarnate. The gear inherits all upgrade, affix and gem values as stored bonuses.
tooltip.gear_forge.curse_anvil: When equipped: nearby neutral mobs are provoked (tamed pets excluded) | EXP Gain +15% | Enchanting Table level requirement -5 (enchantment power drops with it)
message.gear_forge.upgrade_destroyed: Upgrade failed, the gear was destroyed
message.gear_forge.upgrade_fail: Upgrade failed, the level is unchanged
tooltip.gear_forge.yaokin_hammer: Place in the smithing table material slot with a sword to reforge it into a Curved Blade of the same tier (diamond / netherite / yaokin).
tooltip.gear_forge.yaokin_apple: An upgraded Golden Apple: longer Absorption/Regeneration, more saturation, and Midas Touch II.
tooltip.gear_forge.yaokin_coin: Luck +1. While also wearing the Lucky Diamond, its luck is doubled; killing a mob grants 30s of Midas Touch I.
tooltip.gear_forge.curved_blade: Longer reach, faster swings, slightly lower damage. Every 3rd hit unleashes a sweeping slash.
jei.gear_forge.curved_blade: Reforge a sword into a Curved Blade of the same tier
tooltip.gear_forge.stored_bonuses_hint: Hold Ctrl to see reincarnation inherited details
tooltip.gear_forge.reincarnation_cost: ✦ Reincarnation cost: place %s x %s in the template slot
tooltip.gear_forge.sakura_sword: Hits apply Cherry Marks; at 5 marks a cherry tree instantly grows and deals area damage.
tooltip.gear_forge.sakura_pickaxe: Chops like an axe; turns logs into cherry logs and drops cobblestone (rarely ore).
tooltip.gear_forge.sakura_hoe: Right-click crops/saplings to fertilize at the cost of durability.
tooltip.gear_forge.sakura_cookie: Restores more hunger and grants Health Boost I for 3 minutes.
tooltip.gear_forge.sakura_stone: On armor: Cherry Blessing I (10% magic damage reduction). On weapon: applies Cherry Marks.
tooltip.gear_forge.sakura_set: Wearing all four pieces grants Cherry Blessing V (50% magic damage reduction).
tooltip.gear_forge.gem_effect.sakura_ble: On armor: Cherry Blessing I, 10% magic damage reduction
tooltip.gear_forge.gem_effect.sakura_mar: On weapon: applies Cherry Marks on hit
tooltip.gear_forge.yaokin_set: Full set: Midas Touch I + Gilded (Piglins treat as gold armor)
